Mariam El-Sobky 
Called to the Bar by: Lincoln’s Inn, March 2001. 
Type of hearing: 5 Person Disciplinary Tribunal. 
Date of decision: 16 April 2026. 
Charges:  
Charge 1 
Statement of Offence 
 
Professional misconduct, contrary to Core Duty 3 and/or Core Duty 5 of the Bar Standards Board 
Handbook (version 4.6). 
Particulars of Offence 
Mariam El-Sobky, a practising barrister, failed to attend court hearings in the Family Court at 
Wolverhampton on 24 August 2022 and 14 November 2022 when she was still formally on the 
court record as acting for her client, she had been ordered or otherwise required by the Judge to 
attend both hearings, and the hearings had been listed wholly or partly for Ms El-Sobky to account 
for her actions in the proceedings and respond to the court’s questions. In doing so, Ms El-Sobky 
acted without integrity and/or in such a way which is likely to diminish the trust and confidence 
which the public places in her or in the profession.  
Findings: 
Charge 1 
Proved in respect of 24 August 2022 hearing, but not as a breach of Core Duty 3.  
Charge 2 
Dismissed 
 

2 
Sanction: 
The Tribunal ordered that this hearing be adjourned pending sanction, to be re-listed for the first 
available date after 8 September 2026.
